about: Record-retention periods for filed reports, each cited to the official legal text (act, article, URL, the sentence that sets the period). Verified 2026-09-28 against the official publications. 'coverage' says whether the law names the document ('named') or covers it through general wording such as books or records ('indirect'). Tax-law periods are not included and may be longer. No rule states a period of its own.

runs_from.end_of_calendar_year_prepared: 31 December of the year the report was prepared (frozen)
runs_from.end_of_period_year: 31 December of the calendar year the reporting period ends in
runs_from.publication: the day the report was published (submitted)

DE.quote: Die in Absatz 1 Nummer 1 aufgeführten Unterlagen sind zehn Jahre, die in Absatz 1 Nummer 4 aufgeführten Unterlagen acht Jahre … aufzubewahren.
DE.note: Jahresabschluss and Lagebericht are named. The 2025 change (BEG IV) shortened only accounting vouchers to 8 years.

AT.quote: …Jahresabschlüsse samt den Lageberichten, Konzernabschlüsse samt den Konzernlageberichten … sieben Jahre lang geordnet aufzubewahren

SE.quote: De ska bevaras fram till och med det sjunde året efter utgången av det kalenderår då räkenskapsåret avslutades (bevarandetid).

DK.quote: Virksomheder skal på betryggende vis opbevare regnskabsmateriale, jf. § 4, i 5 år fra udgangen af det regnskabsår, materialet vedrører
DK.note: Regnskabsmateriale includes the statutory accounts and the documentation behind the ledelsesberetning (§ 4).

PL.quote: Zatwierdzone roczne sprawozdania finansowe … podlegają przechowywaniu przez okres co najmniej 5 lat, licząc od początku roku następującego po roku obrotowym, w którym zatwierdzono…
PL.note: Permanent retention ended on 31 Dec 2021; now at least 5 years.

PL.quote: pozostałe dowody księgowe i sprawozdania, których obowiązek sporządzenia wynika z ustawy – 5 lat.
PL.note: The management report falls under 'other reports required by the Act' (pkt 8) — a reading of the text.

FR.quote: Les documents comptables et les pièces justificatives sont conservés pendant dix ans.
FR.note: The article names 'documents comptables'; it does not name the management report or say when the period starts — counted conservatively from the end of the year the report was prepared.

NL.quote: Het bestuur is verplicht de in de leden 1 en 2 bedoelde boeken, bescheiden en andere gegevensdragers gedurende zeven jaren te bewaren.
NL.note: Covers books and records including the balance sheet and P&L; the management report is not named and the start is not stated — counted conservatively from the end of the year the report was prepared.

ES.quote: …debidamente ordenados, durante seis años, a partir del último asiento realizado en los libros…
ES.note: Covers books, documentation and supporting evidence; the management report is not named.

IT.quote: Le scritture devono essere conservate per dieci anni dalla data dell'ultima registrazione.
IT.note: Covers accounting records ('scritture'); the balance sheet through the inventory book; the management report is not named.

LU.quote: …doivent être conservés pendant dix ans à partir de la clôture de l'exercice auquel ils se rapportent.
LU.note: Covers the comptes annuels (art. 15); the management report is not named.

PT.quote: Todo o comerciante é obrigado a arquivar … a sua escrituração mercantil e os documentos a ela relativos, devendo conservar tudo pelo período de 10 anos.
PT.note: Covers bookkeeping and related documents; neither the accounts nor the management report is named, and no start is stated — counted conservatively from the end of the year the report was prepared.

BE.quote: …tenues de conserver leurs livres pendant sept ans à partir du premier janvier de l'année qui suit leur clôture.
BE.note: Covers books; the annual accounts and management report are not named.

GB.note: UK company law sets a period for accounting records only (3 years private / 6 years public); it sets none for the annual accounts or the directors' report.

IE.note: Irish company law sets a period for accounting records only (6 years); it sets none for the annual accounts or the directors' report.

td_art4.quote: …and shall ensure that it remains publicly available for at least 10 years.
td_art4.covers_label: annual financial report of an issuer with listed securities (incl. management report and sustainability statement)

crr_434.quote: That archive shall be kept accessible for a period that shall be no less than the storage period set by national law for information included in the institutions' financial reports.
crr_434.covers_label: Pillar 3 disclosure archive — as long as national law keeps financial reports

sii_301.quote: …that report shall remain available on that website for at least five years after the disclosure date referred to in Article 300(1).
sii_301.covers_label: Solvency and Financial Condition Report on the website
sii_301.note: From 30 January 2027 (Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/269) both parts of the split SFCR, same five years.

eudr_4_3.quote: Operators shall keep a record of the due diligence statements for five years from the date the statement is submitted through the information system…

sfdr_none.quote: …shall ensure that any information published in accordance with Article 3, 5 or 10 is kept up to date.
sfdr_none.note: SFDR sets no retention period (it requires disclosures to be kept up to date; the RTS compares with up to the last five periods). Set your own policy (Settings).

sii_orsa_none.quote: …the ORSA supervisory report referred to in Article 304(1)(c) within 2 weeks after concluding the assessment.
sii_orsa_none.note: Solvency II sets when the ORSA supervisory report is submitted, not how long it is kept. Set your own policy (Settings).

irrd_none.quote: …Supervisory authorities shall ensure that insurance and reinsurance undertakings update their pre-emptive recovery plans at least every two years…
irrd_none.note: IRRD sets how often the plan is updated, not how long a superseded plan is kept. Set your own policy (Settings).

eudr_4a_1.quote: The obligations laid down in Article 4(2), Article 4(3), second sentence, and Article 4(4), point (c), shall not apply to micro or small primary operators.
eudr_4a_1.note: The Regulation sets no period for keeping the simplified declaration itself: the five-year record of Art. 4(3), second sentence, does not apply to micro or small primary operators. The information it rests on is kept for five years from each placing on the market or export (Art. 9(1)). Set your own policy (Settings).
